strings.Ui_Settings_Item_DevBuilds_Desc: When enabled, update checks include dev builds; when off, only stable releases are tracked.
strings.Ui_Settings_Section_General_Desc: Behaviour that is not tied to a specific instance.
strings.Ui_Settings_Item_AutoStartInstance_Desc: Pick one of the registered instances; choosing “do not open automatically” means you select an instance manually after launch.
strings.Ui_Settings_Section_Instance_Desc: The instance opened automatically when this app starts.
strings.Ui_Settings_Item_DownloadCacheDir_Desc: Leave empty to use Core's default cache folder.
strings.Ui_Settings_Section_DownloadCache_Desc: Where mod archives are cached and the size cap.
strings.Ui_Settings_Item_CacheSizeLimit_Desc: Above the cap, cache management runs “trim to cap”; leave empty for no limit.
strings.Ui_Settings_Section_Repository_Desc: How often repository metadata refreshes and the host priority.
strings.Ui_Settings_Item_RefreshRate_Desc: 0 means no automatic refresh; leave empty to use the default.
strings.Ui_Settings_Item_PreferredHosts_Desc: One host per line, top to bottom by priority; an empty line marks where the remaining hosts go.
strings.Ui_Settings_Section_AuthToken_Desc: Access tokens per host; the UI only shows a masked preview and plaintext is never logged.
strings.Ui_Settings_Section_Appearance_Desc: Theme, language and density; written to ckan-ui.json only, never to Core config.
strings.Ui_Settings_Item_Theme_Desc: The high contrast theme is forced when system high contrast is on (P-01).
strings.Ui_Settings_Item_Locale_Desc: Language changes take effect after restarting the app.
strings.Ui_Settings_Item_Density_Desc: Compact, standard and comfortable affect row height and padding (P-08); applied right after saving.
strings.Ui_Settings_Item_FontScale_Desc: Five steps from 90% to 130%, scaling only UI text and headings; data text such as mod names and versions keeps its size (P-09).
strings.Ui_Settings_Item_AccentColor_Desc: Twelve presets plus follow-system (P-03); applied immediately.
strings.Ui_Settings_Item_AccentColorCustom_Desc: Enter #RRGGBB (for example #1F6FEB); on save the contrast against the background is checked for WCAG AA (at least 4.5:1), and a value that fails is rejected with a suggested colour (P-03). Leave empty to go back to the presets above.
strings.Ui_Settings_Item_AccentScope_Desc: Global = one accent colour for all instances; per instance = a separate colour for the current instance, switched automatically when you switch instances (P-07).
strings.Ui_Settings_Item_RadiusScale_Desc: Three corner radius ratios (P-05); square, standard soft corners or large round corners.
strings.Ui_Settings_Item_BackdropKind_Desc: Windows backdrop materials (P-04); auto, Mica, Acrylic or solid.
strings.Ui_Settings_Item_MotionIntensity_Desc: Strength of UI animations and transitions (P-10). Follows the system “reduce motion” setting by default; the reduced step keeps only a 90 ms hover and press response.
strings.Ui_Settings_Item_BackgroundKind_Desc: Background behind empty window areas (P-06): solid, gradient, local image or the newest screenshot of the current instance; cards stay opaque so text remains readable. No background is drawn under system high contrast.
strings.Ui_Settings_Item_BackgroundColor_Desc: Colour used by the solid source, as #RRGGBB (for example #1B1F27).
strings.Ui_Settings_Item_BackgroundGradientStart: Start colour of the gradient source, as #RRGGBB.
strings.Ui_Settings_Item_BackgroundGradientEnd_D: End colour of the gradient source, as #RRGGBB.
strings.Ui_Settings_Item_BackgroundImagePath_Des: Absolute path to a local image (PNG/JPG/BMP); decoded at 1600 px wide, falling back to no background when it cannot be read.
strings.Ui_Settings_Item_BackgroundFill_Desc: How the image is placed when it is larger than the window (P-06).
strings.Ui_Settings_Item_BackgroundDim_Desc: Puts a black layer over the background; higher percentages make text clearer (0–100).
strings.Ui_Settings_Item_BackgroundBlur_Desc: Blur radius (0–64 px); 0 means no blur.
strings.Ui_Settings_Item_BackgroundOpacity_Desc: Overall opacity percentage of the background layer (0–100).
strings.Ui_Settings_Item_BackgroundScope_Desc: “Current instance only” stores the whole background in BackgroundByInstance (P-07); switching back to “global” removes this instance's override.
strings.Ui_Settings_Item_StabilityTolerance_Desc: Written to the current instance's CKAN/stability_tolerance.json and only affects that instance; “stable” installs only mods marked stable.
strings.Ui_Settings_Section_Compatibility_Desc: Per-instance stable tolerance and the game-wide install filters.
strings.Ui_Settings_Item_GlobalInstallFiltersKsp: One filter expression per line, for example not:*.zip; leave empty for no filtering.
One filter expression per line, for example not:*.zip; leave empty for no filtering.
strings.Ui_Settings_Item_AutoSortUpdates_Desc: The mod list puts mods with updates at the top by default.
strings.Ui_Settings_Item_SuppressRecommendations: Skips the recommended mods dialog when installing; you can change it back in that dialog at any time.
strings.Ui_Settings_Item_MinimizeToTray_Desc: When minimised, keep only a tray icon instead of a taskbar entry.
strings.Ui_Settings_Item_CloseToTray_Desc: The close button hides the window instead of exiting; use “Exit” in the tray menu to quit.
strings.Ui_Settings_Section_Advanced_Desc: Diagnostics can be pasted straight into an issue; the folder buttons open the matching location in your file manager.

strings.Ui_Unmanaged_Empty_Hint: Every file is already registered as managed; there is nothing left to clean up.
strings.Ui_Unmanaged_NoInstance_Hint: Select or add an instance on the Instances page first.
strings.Ui_Unmanaged_Status_Preview: Preview: {0} item(s) would be deleted (nothing written).
strings.Ui_Unmanaged_Confirm_DeleteDetail: Deleting removes the files from disk immediately and cannot be undone.
strings.Ui_Unmanaged_Confirm_DeleteAgainMessage: This cannot be undone: {0} item(s), {1}. Continue?
strings.Ui_Unmanaged_Confirm_DeleteAgainDetail: Managed files are out of scope here; folders that contain managed content are refused by the service.
strings.Ui_Unmanaged_Confirm_AdoptMessage: Adopt the {0} selected item(s) as managed installs?
strings.Ui_Unmanaged_Confirm_AdoptDetailRegistry: Adopting registers the .dll files in the registry (installed_dlls) and takes a registry.json snapshot before writing.
strings.Ui_Unmanaged_Confirm_AdoptDetailDllOnly: Only .dll files can be adopted; folders are expanded into the DLLs they contain.
strings.Ui_Unmanaged_Error_NoRevealSelection: Select a file or folder first.
strings.Ui_Unmanaged_Error_NoRevealChannel: This host does not provide “show in folder”.
strings.Ui_InstallHistory_Status_Select_Hint: Select a history entry to see the install set of that moment, or to reinstall from that point.
strings.Ui_InstallHistory_Instance_Missing: No game instance is selected, so install history is unavailable.
strings.Ui_InstallHistory_Selection_Summary_None: The install set for the selected point in time appears here.
strings.Ui_InstallHistory_Restore_Hint_No_Select: Select a history entry on the left first.
strings.Ui_InstallHistory_Restore_Hint_No_Snapsh: This entry has no install-set snapshot, so it cannot be reinstalled.
strings.Ui_InstallHistory_Restore_Hint_Empty_Sna: The snapshot for that moment holds no mods, so there is nothing to reinstall.
strings.Ui_InstallHistory_Restore_Hint_Remove_Ex: Reinstalling rewrites the current install set to match that moment and uninstalls mods outside the snapshot (those mods are deleted).
strings.Ui_InstallHistory_Restore_Hint_Keep_Extr: Reinstalling rewrites the current install set to match that moment (mods outside the snapshot are kept).
strings.Ui_InstallHistory_Preview_Remove_Extras_: “Remove mods outside the snapshot” is ticked, so mods not in that snapshot will be uninstalled too.
strings.Ui_InstallHistory_Error_Delete_Unsupport: The current install history service does not support deletion.
strings.Ui_InstallHistory_Confirm_Delete_Message: This deletes the entry {0}｜{1} together with its install-set snapshot, and cannot be undone.
strings.Ui_InstallHistory_Error_Delete_Failed: Failed to delete the install history entry.
strings.Ui_InstallHistory_Status_Gone: That entry no longer exists (the list has been refreshed).
strings.Ui_InstallHistory_Error_Clear_Unsupporte: The current install history service does not support clearing.
strings.Ui_InstallHistory_Confirm_Clear_Message: This deletes all install history of the current instance ({0}) and cannot be undone.
strings.Ui_InstallHistory_Status_Empty_History: No history yet: installing, removing or upgrading any mod records an entry automatically.
strings.Ui_InstallHistory_Error_No_Dialogs: This host has no confirmation dialog, so the operation was cancelled.
strings.Ui_InstallHistory_Error_Conflicts: The reinstall target has dependency conflicts, so it was aborted: {0}
strings.Ui_InstallHistory_Preview_No_Change: That moment already matches the current install set, so no reinstall is needed.
strings.Ui_InstallHistory_Status_Already_Matches: Nothing to reinstall: the current install set already matches that moment.
strings.Ui_InstallHistory_Error_Restore_Failed: Reinstalling from history failed; you can retry.
strings.Ui_Changes_Conflict_Title: {0} conflicts — resolve them before you can start
strings.Ui_Changes_Conflict_Hint: Conflicts need manual resolution; this page does not decide for you.
strings.Ui_Changes_Game_Running_Hint: The game process of the current instance is still running; installing or removing mods may contend for files with the game and corrupt mods. Quit the game completely first; if you really want to continue, click Apply anyway.
strings.Ui_Changes_Empty_State_Title: No changes are waiting to be applied
strings.Ui_Changes_Empty_Hint_No_Service: The change set service is not wired up yet (INT-07), so this page cannot resolve dependencies or conflicts for now.
strings.Ui_Changes_Empty_Hint_Empty_Preview: The change set is empty: every requested item is already up to date or excluded by the install filters.
strings.Ui_Changes_Empty_Hint_No_Requests: Tick the mods to install or remove on the Mods page first.
strings.Ui_Changes_Status_No_Change_Set_Service: The change set service is not wired up yet (INT-07), so only the request count is shown and dependencies cannot be resolved.
strings.Ui_Changes_Status_Computed_With_Conflict: The change set is ready, but {0} conflicts must be resolved first.
strings.Ui_Changes_Status_Computed_Ready: The change set is ready; you can start.
strings.Ui_Changes_Error_Build_Failed: Failed to compute the change set. See the error panel.
strings.Ui_Changes_Error_Build_Exception: An error occurred while computing the change set.
strings.Ui_Changes_Error_Apply_Failed: Failed to apply the changes. See the error panel.
strings.Ui_Changes_Error_Residual_Cleanup: An error occurred while cleaning residual directories; the removal itself completed.
strings.Ui_Changes_Error_Game_Running_Probe: Could not determine whether the game is running; assumed it is not.
strings.Ui_Changes_Status_Recommendation_Cancell: Recommendation selection cancelled; nothing was done.
strings.Ui_Changes_Result_Rolled_Back: The transaction was rolled back; the game directory was not modified.
strings.Ui_Changes_Error_Apply_Exception_Status: An error occurred while applying changes. See the error panel.
strings.Ui_Changes_Error_Apply_Exception: An error occurred while applying changes.
strings.Ui_Changes_Status_Cancelling: Cancelling… (cancelling during install triggers a transaction rollback)
strings.Ui_Changes_Status_Nothing_To_Cancel: The task has already finished; there is nothing to cancel.
strings.Ui_Changes_Status_Removed_From_Set: Removed {0} from the change set (click Recompute to restore the authoritative result).
strings.Ui_Changes_Error_No_Dialog_Conflict: The mod dialog service is not wired up, so conflict details cannot be shown.
strings.Ui_Changes_Error_Show_Conflict_Details: An error occurred while showing conflict details.
strings.Ui_Changes_Recommendation_Dialog_Message: Recommended, suggested or supporting items were detected. Choose whether to install them as well:
strings.Ui_Changes_Error_Recommendation_Dialog: An error occurred in the recommendation dialog.
strings.Ui_Changes_Error_No_Dialog_Virtual: The mod dialog service is not wired up, so a virtual module cannot be chosen.
strings.Ui_Changes_Status_Virtual_Module_Selecte: Selected “{0}” as the virtual module provider.
strings.Ui_Changes_Status_Virtual_Module_Cancell: Virtual module provider selection cancelled; nothing was done.
strings.Ui_Changes_Error_Virtual_Module_Dialog: An error occurred while choosing a virtual module provider.
strings.Ui_Changes_Missing_Installer: The installer arrives in M2 (INT-08): for now you can only preview changes, not actually install them.
